title: while and do-while
instructions: A while loop repeats as long as a condition stays true. It checks the condition FIRST, before each run.
Important: something inside the loop must eventually make the condition false, or it runs forever. Usually you change a counter like count++.
A do-while is the same idea but checks the condition LAST, so the body always runs at least once.
task: Add the line that increases count so the loop ends and prints 1, 2, 3.
